capabilities.title: Charging Priority
capabilities.support_notes: SmartValue proxy evidence from Gootu GT-H2436M14P5 hardware captured CPR03 and CPR00 writes with ACK responses. The CPR01 and CPR02 values use the same document-backed JSDSOLAR command family; output-priority OPR writes are intentionally not exposed for this model because no device ACK was captured.
capabilities.change_summary: Changes which source has priority for battery charging.
